notes: Reached with curl_cffi chrome impersonation (plain fetch = HTTP 403; r.jina.ai returned a Cloudflare challenge under batch concurrency). Room & Board publishes NO 'N items' header anywhere on its PLPs, and exposes no count API. Every PLP is a Next.js page that server-renders its ENTIRE listing with no pagination, so each qty is an exhaustive enumeration of the listing, cross-verified three independent ways that agreed on every category checked: (a) props.pageProps.document.productGroups array length, (b) count of schema.org Product entries in the server-rendered JSON-LD, (c) count of distinct product-tile hrefs in the rendered HTML grid. Verified all three agree on table-lamps=34, sofas-and-loveseats=56, pendant-lights=57, prints-and-silkscreens=88, tabletop=49, vases-and-bowls=14. qty counts product tiles (product groups, e.g. 'Focus Wall Mirrors' = one tile covering several sizes) - this is exactly what the shopper sees on the grid. Furniture-led catalogue, so the in-scope list is short by design. Excluded as out of scope: Ceiling Fans, LED Light Bulbs, Baskets & Bins (hampers/waste baskets/storage boxes), Cabinet Hardware, Kitchen Tools, Care & Cleaning, all pillows/blankets/rugs/bedding (textiles), bath, Gift Ideas / Gifts Under $100 / Seasonal Favorites, and Entertainment & Novelty (bookends + a cribbage board; category identity is games, not decor). 'Limited Edition Wall Art' is documentType=EDITORIAL - a curated landing page with no product listing - so it was dropped. Skipped pure re-cuts of the same SKUs to avoid double counting: Lighting by Room, Primary/Accent/Task Lighting, and the Outdoor Planters / Outdoor Decor & Entertaining pages (near-total overlap with Home Decor > Planters and > Trays). | RULE 0 TOP-UP (2026-08-10): Original extraction explicitly skipped 'Lighting by Room' as a presumed re-cut of the type-based Lighting listing (see original notes above). Rule 0.6 corrects this: a room tree alongside a type tree is two genuine nav branches, not a re-cut. Re-fetched https://www.roomandboard.com/catalog/lighting/lighting-by-room with curl_cffi chrome131 impersonation (plain fetch still 403) and found exactly 6 room nodes under 'Lighting by Room': Living Room Lighting (142), Dining Room & Kitchen Lighting (118), Bedroom Lighting (141), Bath Lighting (67), Entryway Lighting (105), Office Lighting (51) - all added, each independently cross-verified via __NEXT_DATA__ productGroups length against the page's embedded application/ld+json Product graph (both agreed exactly on all 6). No 'Outdoor' or 'Vanity' node exists inside Lighting by Room specifically (Outdoor Lighting remains the pre-existing top-level row; its productGroups are identical whether reached via /catalog/lighting/outdoor-lighting or /catalog/outdoor/outdoor-lighting, confirmed duplicate, not double-counted). Also searched every department (bath, bedroom, living, dining-and-kitchen, office, storage-and-entryway, outdoor) via the site's own /catalog/sitemap page for any other lighting/mirror branch: found and added Bathroom Mirrors (/catalog/bath/mirrors-and-medicine-cabinets, 30 genuine mirrors after excluding medicine-cabinet hardware and one wall shelf) and Custom Bathroom Mirrors (/catalog/made-for-you/custom-bathroom-mirrors, 7, disjoint SKU set from the existing Custom Mirrors row). Confirmed as duplicates/re-cuts and deliberately NOT added: /catalog/storage-and-entryway/mirrors (canonical redirect to home-decor/mirrors, 33=33), /catalog/outdoor/outdoor-lighting (identical 7-SKU set to lighting/outdoor-lighting), /catalog/storage-and-entryway/entryway-lighting (identical 105-SKU set to lighting/entryway-lighting), and /catalog/bath/lighting's 3 fixture-type sub-pages (wall-sconces+ceiling-lights+pendant-lights = 50 items, 49 of which already appear in Bath Lighting's 67 - a re-cut of the same room curation by fixture type, not a distinct branch). No other missing room-based lighting/mirror branch found (bedroom-decor, office-decor, living-room-decor, dining-and-kitchen-decor landing pages all cross-link to categories already in this file, none new).
